headline: Controlling BP-AKR Gas Stations, AKRA Explains Impact on Operations and Finances
summary: AKR Corporindo (AKRA) has increased its ownership in Aneka Petroindo Raya. The report discusses the impact on operations and finances from controlling BP-AKR fuel stations.
why: AKR Corporindo is an Indonesian listed distributor of fuel, chemicals and logistics, and fuel retail is a core part of its business.
original_headline: Kuasai SPBU BP-AKR, AKRA Beberkan Dampak ke Operasional dan Keuangan
